crons.name: heartbeat
crons.prompt: Read HEARTBEAT.md and follow its instructions. Update your heartbeat, check inbox, and work on your highest priority task. NIGHT MODE: if local time is between 00:00 and 08:00 America/New_York, silent heartbeat (touch heartbeat file but no Telegram surfacing, no active drafting work).

crons.name: nanoneuro-biweekly-update
crons.prompt: CADENCE GUARD (added 2026-07-01): this cron now fires WEEKLY (Tue 10am ET) as a workaround for a scheduler quirk — never-fired interval crons ('14d') reset their timer on every daemon restart and this cron had NEVER fired since 2026-05-14. The biweekly cadence is enforced here instead: FIRST read vault Projects/NanoNeuroscience Data Platform/Log.md and find the date of the last biweekly client update sent. If it was sent fewer than 13 days ago, exit silently — do NOT draft. Otherwise proceed: Draft NanoNeuro biweekly client update. Invoke sebastian-brand skill FIRST for voice + per-client config. Read vault Projects/NanoNeuroscience Data Platform/Context.md + Log.md (last 14d) for what to surface. Pull git activity + Phase status from .planning/ROADMAP.md. Stage draft via mcp__claude_ai_Gmail__create_draft (Gmail-draft, NOT auto-send) + bus seb_boss with Telegram preview. Sebastian-hand on send.
crons.description: NanoNeuro biweekly draft — weekly fire + 13-day guard (was dead 14d interval)

crons.name: nightly-metrics
crons.prompt: Run nightly metrics collection: cortextos bus collect-metrics. Review the output and report any anomalies via Telegram to the orchestrator.

crons.name: catalog-browse
crons.prompt: Read .claude/skills/catalog-browse/SKILL.md and execute the catalog browse workflow. Check for new community skills and recommend useful ones.

crons.name: voice-card-weekly
crons.prompt: Day-mode only: run python skills/voice-feedback/scripts/aggregate_week.py for the current ISO week, then surface the resulting voice card (vault _AI_Inbox/voice-card-<week>.md) to seb_boss with a 2-line summary of proposed SSOT updates. PROPOSE-ONLY, never auto-edit sebastian-brand.

crons.name: brand-voice-calibration
crons.prompt: G2 weekly voice calibration: run python /c/Users/Sebas/dev/brand-feedback-loop/brand_feedback.py weekly-scan 2>&1. If output shows pairs processed, bus seb_boss low with summary. If no pairs found, silent. Monday 3am UTC (Sunday night).
